description:
There is a famously popular guy on campus, regardless of gender. His name is Baek Hwi-chan. The only rumor I care about is that he's a 'slut with incredible bed skills.'

"I heard you're really good at it, senior?"  
"At what?"  
"...Se-, sex."  
"If you're curious, why don't you sleep with me once?"

With morals thrown out the window, his loose lower half made temptation all too easy.

"When did you lose your virginity?"  
"...I-I don't know."   
"How many times have you been laid for you not to even know?"

A satisfying one-night stand would be enough.

"Chae-i. I think you're screwed."

After all, the senior won't remember today anyway.
